title: Ext-defined projective dimension is invariant under linear equivalence between universes
statement: Let $R$ be a ring small in each of two module universes, let $M$ and $N$ be $R$-modules in these universes, and let $e:M\simeq_R N$ be a linear equivalence. If $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,Y)=0$ for every module $Y$ in the universe of $M$ and every $i\ge n+1$, then $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(N,Z)=0$ for every module $Z$ in the universe of $N$ and every $i\ge n+1$. Here Ext and HasProjectiveDimensionLE are Mathlib's categorical notions [def-pc-ext].

proof.text: Apply Mathlib ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_linearEquiv to e and n. Its source proof inducts on n using canonical free surjections and dimension shifting; at n=0 projectivity is invariant under linear equivalence, and the induction step identifies the kernels of the two free surjections under the induced equivalence. Smallness of the ring in both universes ensures that these free modules exist in the required universes.
